'''Dave Mailloux''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Bridgewater tournament]] on 23 February 2001 with Scimitar TIE Bomber Tech, according to Jon Bragg's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1787">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mr-wow-goes-to-bridgewater-ma-02-25-00d1787/ mr-wow-goes-to-bridgewater-ma-02-25-00], DeckTech (Jon "Wow" Bragg, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mr-wow-goes-to-bridgewater-ma-02-25-00d1787/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
